summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn, with a lived-in home, lake and creek activities, Tower Gardens, market districts, and a royal city beneath a hilltop castle. Authored cell scenes combine interactive behaviors, roster-driven NPC crowds, and procedural structure families; terrain marks grade, clear, and surface their sites and connecting routes.
places: places/main - forest world linking Spawn/home and lake, creek sites, camps/corral, market town, Garden Market, royal city/castle and hilltop village
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn hub: tree-centered home/studio, creek, activities and Tower Gardens at (57,-26); includes blueprint farm anchors east/west
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - lake/islet, maze, blossom walk and camps; dock/rowboat fishing reaches lake and creek mouth
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene - market square and folk crowd near z≈128; royal city at z≈150-200 with avenue, guard NPCs, houses and plaza
places/main/cells/x-1z1.scene - Garden Market at (-82,78), its roster-driven gardeners, ring signpost and district ground
places/main/cells/x1z1.scene - hilltop village at (172,90): green, six cottages, hall, well, firepit, garden, paths and village-crowd manager
places/main/cells/x0z2.scene - royal castle on plateau centered near (0,263.5), with gate/stair/keep/towers/walls and surrounding royal houses
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain/water, site/path/clearing marks and seeded vegetation; grades royal moat/avenue, castle plateau/stair cut and hill trail/village paths
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: main place, player/camera templates, arrival, input actions and UI
templates/player.js#player - player root with movement, locomotion, home interaction, delete, travel, alchemy and mount handlers
templates/camera.js#camera - custom first-/third-person camera; camera behavior accounts for controlled mounts and seated rowboat
places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - configured terrain, height/material interface, water and landscape marks
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - Spawn's tree-centered multilevel home and below-floor art studio
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#garden-greenhouse / garden-bed-* / garden-pump - Tower Gardens structure and crop cycle
places/main/cells/x1z1.scene#village-crowd - hilltop roster-driven villager manager; child village homes and shared green are authored in scene
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene#folk-crowd / royal-guard-* / royal-castle (x0z2) - market/royal NPCs and now-built royal district and castle
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightAt(ctx)/materialAt(ctx) contract for terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - seeded vegetation geometry reused by configured decoration layers and corridor greenbelt
scripts/lib/road-solid.js + scripts/lib/solid-kit.js - shared solid/collider construction for road and site builders
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and interaction tuning
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - mount/seat/dismount coordination shared by Violet, rowboat, courier horse and zipline trolley
scripts/lib/town-kit.js - geometry/material helpers reused by town civic, lane, Garden Market, rampart and town-link builders
scripts/lib/royal-kit.js - white-stone/slate/gold geometry and arch/tower helpers for royal-district, cathedral, house and statue builders
scripts/lib/village-mesh.js - low-level mesh kit shared by hex-cottage, village-kit and villager; scripts/lib/data/{folk,garden-crowd,village-crowd}.yml supply NPC rosters/tuning
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/camera.js - onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt)
scripts/ui.js - default(ctx, player), HUD for travel, courier, secrets, alchemy, mushrooms, boat fishing and garden state
scripts/rowboat.js - ears.press, onSpawn(ctx), onControlEnd(ctx,player), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/fish-pose.js - present()
scripts/garden-plot.js - grow(ctx,p), onSpawn(ctx), ears.press; scripts/garden-station.js - onSpawn(ctx), ears.press
scripts/folk-crowd.js, garden-crowd.js, village-crowd.js - scheduled update and ears.press handlers for spawned district NPC groups; scripts/royal-guard.js - onSpawn(ctx), ears.press
scripts/gen/folk.js - WHO, heightOf(who), skeleton(ctx), geometry(ctx); scripts/gen/villager.js - skeleton(), geometry(ctx)
scripts/gen/royal-castle.js, royal-house.js, village-kit.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/gen/royal-district.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - movement intent, velocity, jump, flight, rope and camera mode; movement scratch remains in ctx.session
scripts/alchemy-player.js, scripts/pond-seed.js, fishing-tackle.js + activity data - harvest spending/buff, seeds/gotSeeds and legacy fishing state
scripts/rowboat.js + scripts/lib/data/rowboat.js - boat rider/fishing phase and child rod/bobber/line/catch; local movement scratch in ctx.session.rowboat; fish count/fishGet on rider
scripts/garden-plot.js + scripts/lib/data/garden.js - bed crop/stage/wet/grow timer/golden state; player.state.garden owns seeds, selected crop, watering-can charges and harvest basket
scripts/wild-mushroom.js + scripts/lib/data/mushrooms.js - each patch's picked/regrow state; picked inventory is player state
scripts/folk-crowd.js + scripts/lib/data/folk.yml; scripts/garden-crowd.js + garden-crowd.yml - district roster/person dialogue, movement and animation scratch; manager session state is transient
scripts/village-crowd.js + scripts/lib/data/village-crowd.yml - villager roster, roles/dialogue and walking/garden/sit behavior; individual NPC state and manager scratch are separate
scripts/horse-summon.js + scripts/steed.js and scripts/corral-horses.js + corral data - summoned mount/rider and corral horse behavior
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands; site/path marks grade, clear and seed vegetation
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; templates/player.js attaches home interaction, travel, alchemy and horse handlers
Z input -> scripts/horse-summon.js spawns session steed using steed data and courier-horse geometry -> scripts/steed.js controls horse/rider
player presses mandala-crystal -> harvest; alchemy-bench press -> alchemyOpen -> alchemy-player brew spends harvest and sets buff -> scripts/ui.js displays panel/status
pond seed trigger/pouch press -> scripts/pond-seed.js -> player seeds/gotSeeds; fishing-tackle press/cast/reel -> player fish count and catch feedback
dock rowboat E -> rider seat/control; W/S/A/D -> scripts/rowboat.js movement bounded by terrain water/depth; E near shore exits
seated rowboat fish input -> scripts/rowboat.js cast/wait/bite/hook/present phases -> catch-fish child mesh, fish-pose animation and rider fish/fishGet -> scripts/ui.js hint/banner
garden seed crate/pump press -> scripts/garden-station.js -> player.state.garden seeds/can; garden-bed press -> scripts/garden-plot.js plants, spends water, schedules growth, harvests to basket/HUD
greenhouse garden beds (gh:true) -> garden-plot growth behavior, which keeps watered greenhouse beds wet; Tower Gardens layout/geometry use garden data and tg builders
wild-mushroom scene patches -> scripts/wild-mushroom.js press/pick and timed regrow -> mushroom inventory/HUD in scripts/ui.js
folk.yml + garden-crowd.yml -> folk-crowd.js / garden-crowd.js spawn and animate district characters from their generator/clip sets; E press selects nearby NPC dialogue

village-crowd manager + village-crowd.yml -> villager generator and anim/villager.yml clips; villager role/position and press dialogue drive walking, gardening and sitting; config paths grade village routes
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest flora varied by layer, kind and terrain
scripts/gen/cob-house.js + scripts/gen/cob-furnish.js - tree-centered multilevel home/furnishing varied by item, dimensions, palette and seed; art-studio builder supplies lower-level props
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed; terrain roads separately supply edges/shoulders
scripts/gen/town-lane.js + town-rampart.js - road/dressing and limestone boundary/service-yard geometry varied by points, gaps, item and seed
scripts/gen/town-square.js + town-kit - town/civic geometry varied by kind, palette, seed and placement; town-banner adds dragon/lion heraldic cloth
scripts/gen/town-link.js + scripts/lib/data/town-links.json - lamped lane, signpost/finger and name-plaque forms varied by kind and placed text; terrain config provides matching paving paths
scripts/gen/garden-district.js + scripts/lib/data/garden-district.json - Garden Market ground, fountain, stalls, dressing and pondwater vary by item and authored layout

scripts/gen/folk.js + folk.yml/anim/folk.yml and gen/villager.js + village-crowd.yml/anim/villager.yml - rostered animated people vary by role, outfit, dialogue, route and district; royal-house/castle + village-kit build their respective settlement families
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used
scripts/gen/garden-garb.js and scripts/gen/garden-wear.js - builders have no current scene or template references
scripts/gen/royal-cathedral.js and scripts/gen/royal-statue.js - no current scene attachments found; the royal-city/castle scenes use other builders
migrationNotes: forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main river is at sea level y=0, ground around y=0.5, Spawn clearing near (0,-3).
Keep terrain material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated with scene placements; routes are terrain-config marks while scene builders supply visible structures and paving.
The royal moat is at z≈155.8 with water level 0; royal district is centered z≈186; castle plateau centered (0,263.5) at y=14 with stair cut near z=229-245.5.
Hill village datum is world (172,20,90); village-kit/hex-cottage child coordinates are local to its root; plateau and path heights/grades are set in main config.

Tower Gardens beds and structures use ground feet at y=0.5; greenhouse is centered (58,-33), garden stations/bed coordinates share the tower-gardens data datum, and greenhouse beds stay wet during timed growth.

Rowboat bow is local +Z; it is kinematic and constrained by terrain depth/open-water range. Fish animation masks from Spine so seated legs stay put; release/leave clears fishing children and rider animation.
